summary: Arm Holdings plc filed a Form 6-K on September 10, 2026, reporting the results of its 2026 Annual General Meeting held September 9, 2026, at which all ordinary resolutions passed by poll, including receipt of FY2026 accounts, approval of the directors' remuneration policy and report, re-appointment of Deloitte LLP as auditors, and re-election of all eight named directors. No special-situation transaction is present; no stake, price, premium, or deal terms were disclosed. This is a routine AGM results filing, with no board recommendation on a transaction and no advisor named. The risk-arb angle is not applicable.
